sentences.text:
Bajrul Rahaman Mondal & Ors vs The Union Of India & Ors on 9
June, 2023
Author: Suvra Ghosh

Bajrul Rahaman Mondal & Ors.
 Vs.
 The Union of India & ors.
 Adv. Sankar Paul,
 Adv. Imtiaz Ahamad,
 Adv. Tapati Sarkar,
 ...for the petitioners.

Adv. Avipsa Sarkar,
 ...for the Uoi.
 Adv. Surojit Chakraborty,
 ...for the respondent no.7.
Adv. Soumitra Bandyopadhyay, Adv. Srinath Singha Roy, ...for the State.
Affidavit of service filed by the petitioners is taken on record.
The petitioners are aggrieved by the compensation assessed by the authority for acquisition of their land under the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines Act, 1962.
The petitioners seek to withdraw the writ petition and approach the appropriate forum for redressal of their grievance under Section 10(2) of the Act.
In view of the above, the writ petition, being WPA 11896 of 2023, is dismissed for non-prosecution.
Liberty is granted to the petitioners to approach the appropriate forum for redressal of their grievance.
There shall however, be no order as to costs.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be furnished to the parties on usual undertakings.
